name: Kobe Wagyu Yakiniku
reviews: We came to celebrate a birthday with the promotion of half price for every 2nd person. When we arrived, services were prompt and efficient. Most importantly, the quality of all the cuts of Wagyu beef served were of high quality, fresh and delicious. We also thoroughly enjoyed the sashimi, seafood and other sides being offered. After dinner, we were served politely by Tom at the cashier. Overall we had a great experience having the J BBQ Buffet dinner at Kobe Wagyu.

Our experience at Kobe Wagyu Yakiniku was excellent from start to finish. The staff were friendly, attentive, and made us feel very welcome.

The Wagyu was insane. So incredibly soft and succulent. We had plenty of the Buttered Corn as well as the Cheesy Corn! A good touch is too add it into the rice together it's amazing!

Also tired some of the shushi which was amazing! We also had a free beer! They always have a special on which is amazing!

The dessert OMG! They had an amazing mango mochi was INSANE! I loved the texture of the mochi and the mango flavour was insanely delicious. It had a beautiful mango cream in the middle melted in my mouth.

Would highly recommend this place, suitable for birthdays, dinners, outing with family or friends! Definitely recommend trying everything they have!

For dessert definitely recommend trying the mango mochi you won't regret it!

Honestly, better quality than most BBQ buffets in Sydney. The highlight is definitely the Wagyu—the marbling was great and it actually tasted fresh, not like the frozen stuff you get elsewhere. We ordered a few rounds of the premium cuts, and the texture was tender without being overly greasy.
The seafood was also surprisingly good; the prawns and scallops were fresh and grilled well. Didn't expect much from the sushi since it's a BBQ place, but the sashimi was decent too.
Service was quick with bringing out the meat orders, which is rare for a buffet. Good drinks menu as well. If you're coming for the meat quality, it's worth the price.

Love this Kobe restaurant! The notice asking customers to respect staff really warms my heart. Staff are friendly and attentive, food tastes fantastic. It's lovely to see a business that values its employees, will definitely come back soon!

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Had an amazing birthday dinner at Kobe Wagyu Yakiniku! The quality of the wagyu was excellent, tender and full of flavour. Service was friendly and attentive, and the atmosphere was great for a special occasion.

The highlight was the birthday promotion where the birthday guest receives 50% off, which made the experience even better value. If you're a wagyu lover, it's definitely worth visiting on your birthday.

Highly recommend for anyone looking for quality Japanese BBQ and a great birthday treat!
